description: Create a new local PyPI repository in JFrog Artifactory with the following settings: Repository Key: 'pypi-local', Package Type: PyPI, Description: 'Local Python package index'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Add Repositories > Local Repository, select PyPI as the package type, enter the repository key 'pypi-local', add the description 'Local Python package index', and save. The repository must appear in the repositories list when done.
